greek.notes: BYU does not have fraternities or sororities. According to BYU's student newspaper (BYU Daily Universe, a BYU domain), the university eliminated social institutions resembling Greek fraternities and sororities decades ago, per a BYU student leadership administrator. No FSL office, chapter reports, or recruitment pages exist because BYU has no Greek system. Confirmed also by BYU's Common Data Set filings which report 0% participation in fraternities/sororities.

lgbtq.notes: BYU has no official LGBTQ+ center; USGA (Understanding Sexuality, Gender, and Allyship) is an unofficial, non-university-recognized student group (usgabyu.com) - not an official campus resource. No official university LGBTQ center exists as of recent reporting; searches did not find official pages for gender-inclusive housing, all-gender restrooms list, or student health plan transition-care coverage - likely because BYU (as a religious institution following the Honor Code's chastity/same-sex behavior restrictions) does not publish such pages. The Honor Code (Church Educational System Honor Code) at policy.byu.edu serves as the conduct code applicable to students, including provisions on chastity and "abstaining from same-sex romantic behavior." The nondiscrimination/equal opportunity policy PDF (mirrored via FIRE) is the official BYU policy; a legal.byuh.edu version also exists for BYU-Hawaii (different campus) - included BYU's own PDF for main campus. Name policy: ID Center page describes preferred first name options on ID card/records; did not find a dedicated registrar chosen-name/pronouns policy page beyond this. No trans admission policy found/applicable (BYU is not single-sex). Health insurance plan and restroom map pages not located in search.
